structured_output.summary:
Living room (room-11) furnished in parts/room-11.mjs: hearth on the west wall with a sofa of stairs, rug, coffee table, chairs, jukebox piano, barrel cabinet, three standing lanterns and a hanging lantern on a chain.
In a preview copy the room has min light 8, no dark or dim cells, FIT OK; the walk verdict fails because the house entrance is not built yet.
Not in the real build: runParts refuses all 52 writes, because the shell fills the interior with air and runParts counts that as placed.
left: The shell (parts/shell.mjs:27) fills the whole interior with `air`; runParts counts that as placed, so every write in the living room (and every other room part) is REFUSED. make.sh reports 52 refused writes for room-11 and 0 placed. Fix belongs to the shell owner or the runParts lock (drop the air fill, or treat air as unplaced); re-run make.sh once fixed. Noted in plan.md Notes.

Walk verdict in the preview: 0 of 140 floor cells reachable from the entrance. Cause is global: the front door, steps and joinery are not built in this copy. Re-check with `mcd room build.nbt --only "living room"` after the entrance parts land.
Not verified in the real build: the room's furniture, light and FIT results are from room11-preview.mjs (a plain, unlocked grid copy of build.nbt), not from the locked make.sh build.
plan.md checklist and elements.md were not ticked: the room parts are not in the checklist, and nothing from room-11 reached the real build.

waste.what: Floor layout drawn by hand as 13 text rows of 10 characters, with coordinates for the table top, lanterns and chain worked out cell by cell.
waste.cost: about 4 layout iterations, 3 hand-placed set() calls for the chain and hanging lantern
waste.tool: `mcd plan` could emit a blank layers() template for the room that already has the furniture legend and the lane cells marked, so only the furniture needs drawing.

waste.what: Found out by a failed make.sh run that the shell's air fill locks the room interior, then wrote a separate preview script that loads build.nbt into a plain grid to test the room.
waste.cost: one failed make.sh (about 40 s), one preview build and room check
waste.tool: A `runParts` or `mcd room` preview mode that reports which earlier-part cells are locked, or treats air as unplaced, so a room worker sees the refusal before the build.

waste.what: Light tuning by trial: I guessed where the dim corner was, then used the room check's lamp suggestion.
waste.tool: `mcd room` could print a placed lamp option that matches the lantern it suggests, so the change is one step.

waste.what: Walk verdict is global: the room shows 0 of 140 reachable because the entrance isn't built yet, so the room's own lanes can't be confirmed.
waste.tool: `mcd walk --from <room doorway>` (or a room-local flood from its doorways) so a room's lanes can be checked without the house entrance.
